# United States

Region: North America. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Federal Reserve Financial Services / FedNow

**Role:** Instant payment-system operator

**Reporting coverage:** CAMT052 account reporting and CAMT054 debit/credit notification

**Messages / versions:** camt.052; camt.054; camt.060; pacs

- [FedNow Operating Procedures v3.2 June2025](https://frbservices.org/binaries/content/assets/crsocms/resources/rules-regulations/062425-fednow-service-operating-procedures.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [FedNow Customer Readiness Guide](https://explore.fednow.org/resources/customer-readiness-guide.pdf) — specification; public-file

Public procedures and readiness guidance describe optional CAMT052 balance, activity totals and activity details reports, CAMT060 requests, and CAMT054 correspondent notifications. This is infrastructure reporting, not a universal corporate statement convention. Exact namespace version was not established from reviewed excerpts.

### Federal Reserve Financial Services / Fedwire

**Role:** High-value RTGS operator

**Reporting coverage:** Fedwire CAMT052 account reporting and CAMT060 requests

**Messages / versions:** camt.052; camt.060; admi.002

- [Fedwire Account Reporting FAQ](https://www.frbservices.org/resources/financial-services/wires/fedwire-services-frequently-asked-questions/fedwire-service-iso-20022-faq/account-reporting-faq/) — availability; public-page
- [Request technical-guide/XSD access](https://www.frbservices.org/binaries/content/assets/crsocms/resources/financial-services/request-access-fedwire-funds-iso-20022-technical-guide.pdf) — specification; public-file

The FAQ confirms CAMT052 balance, activity and endpoint reports and CAMT060 requests, rejected through admi.002. Activity reports can paginate at approximately 2,000 transactions or 4 MB per message. Scope is direct Fedwire customers; CAMT053 was not evidenced. Exact namespace version requires the technical guide.

### The Clearing House / CHIPS

**Role:** Private-sector high-value clearing and settlement operator

**Reporting coverage:** ISO 20022 payment migration established; CAMT052/053 statement coverage not established

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 payment messages; exact families not verified

- [CHIPS official document library](https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/CHIPS/CHIPS-Resources) — availability; public-page
- [CHIPS ISO 20022 migration announcement](https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/Articles/2024/04/CHIPS_Network_Migrates_ISO_20022_04-10-2024) — availability; public-page

CHIPS migrated on 2024-04-08. Payment-rail migration alone does not establish corporate CAMT052/053 offerings. Keep this separate from CGI bank-to-corporate reporting.
